posts.title: How I've been introducing my kids to videogames
posts.description: My son is 4 (nearly 5) and my daughter is 6 (nearly 7). They’ve been around gadgets their entire lives, and at this point it’s unavoidable. They’ll happily start their day by coming downstairs and saying “Okay Google, turn on the lights”. I’ve always been wary of using a screen to buy a few moments of peace and quiet.
